newsitem.title: DUBAI: OPEC oil output above ceiling - Iranian official.
newsitem.headline: OPEC oil output above ceiling - Iranian official.

text.p: OPEC oil output is running at around 27 million barrels per day (bpd), above the organisation's agreed supply ceiling of 25.03 million, an Iranian official was quoted as saying on Sunday.

"OPEC produces about 27 million barrels of oil a day while its official ceiling is 25.03 million," the official Iranian news agency IRNA quoted Mohammad Alipour-Jeddi, head of OPEC affairs at Iran's oil ministry, as saying.
Iran's Oil Minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh is expected to chair a regular meeting of OPEC's quota compliance committee this week in the Iranian city of Isfahan.
The meeting is expected to review official and independent assessments of oil production in each of the 11 OPEC states.

OPEC president Libyan Oil Minister Abdalla el-Badri called on members last month to restrain oil output to help support sagging oil prices which have fallen from $24 a barrel at the start of this year to below $18 this month.
"(Alipour-Jeddi) said here Sunday that with no critical political development, there is no reason to expect oil price hikes in the near future," IRNA reported.

Oil prices had fallen because of an increase in crude output by non-OPEC states, quota busting by OPEC states, weaker international oil demand, higher Iraqi flows and increased reserves, IRNA reported.
